author: embirico
text:
@OpenAI ChatGPT macOS release notes
12 days are over—let's celebrate the small, slow & steady improvements from the team last week:
- Sticky button to copy code blocks (📺)
- Keyword search for all chats
- Apple-style custom toolbar layouts
- Squashed bugs

Happy holidays! https://t.co/PIGkl9zcOs

author: embirico
text:
Top feedback on @OpenAIDevs post was "add more apps"
Got you covered
+ VS Code forks: Code Insiders, VSCodium, Cursor, Windsurf
+ JetBrains: Android Studio, IntelliJ, PyCharm, WebStorm, PHPStorm, CLion, Rider, RubyMine, AppCode, GoLand, DataGrip
+ Nova & Prompt by Panic
+ BBEdit https://t.co/eIEbGmkCNw

quoted.text: @OpenAIDevs Who is responsible for including more applications? For example, @cursor_ai

author: embirico
text:
Second ship of the day 📈
We're building ChatGPT into a contextual assistant.
If you're wondering why @openai is building macOS and PC apps—this the beginning of why.

quoted.text:
ChatGPT 🤝 VS Code, Xcode, Terminal, iTerm2

ChatGPT for macOS can now work with apps on your desktop. In this early beta for Plus and Team users, you can let ChatGPT look at coding apps to provide better answers. https://t.co/3wMCZfby2U

author: embirico
text:
ChatGPT Windows app now available for everyone🎉

Ton of improvements since the early version: voice, screenshots, photos, search chats, search the internet, scaling, customization, stability…

Keep the feedback coming, and stay tuned for where we're taking it!

quoted.text:
The ChatGPT desktop app for Windows is now available for all users 🖥️

Get faster access to ChatGPT with the Alt + Space shortcut, and use Advanced Voice Mode to chat with your computer and get hands-free answers while you work.

https://t.co/UzTM7ZGRpt https://t.co/hQ2kyUELpI

author: embirico
text:
Knowledge cutoff banished! Now ChatGPT has access to real time information.

Big by itself. Magical as we start combining it with all the other capabilities we're building.

quoted.text:
🌐 Introducing ChatGPT search 🌐

ChatGPT can now search the web in a much better way than before so you get fast, timely answers with links to relevant web sources.

https://t.co/7yilNgqH9T https://t.co/z8mJWS8J9c

author: embirico
text:
So much to say, but what matters most? Talking to users and shipping. With that in mind...

I couldn’t be more excited to have joined the ChatGPT desktop team. Send me your feedback and bug reports. DMs open!
